entities.name: Mary Corinna Putnam Jacobi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mary Corinna Putnam Jacobi was an English-American physician, teacher, scientist, writer, and suffragist. She was the first woman admitted to study medicine at the University of Paris and the first woman to graduate from a pharmacy college in the United States.
